disposition: Accepted locally for the reported validation UI bug; no hosted acceptance or publication

genuineFailures: Light-theme invalid border remained gray or blue.
Pale summary was outside the mobile viewport.
Validation stopped at the first missing required field.

fixtureCorrections: Server field details intentionally moved from summary to the aria-linked inline error.
Existing CSS border-color transition requires waiting for rendered color before comparing.

visualReview.findings: Focused phone has a red border and readable linked inline message; no horizontal overflow. Full-page screenshots include the fixed navbar at the current focused scroll position.

coverage: Missing/whitespace names, contact cells and business name; malformed phone and optional website; optional website blank remains allowed.
All current-step invalid fields are marked; focus moves to the first invalid field; errors clear only after valid correction.
Input Enter advances once and textarea Enter inserts a newline.
Restored final-step drafts validate every earlier required field before create.
Server field mapping returns to the correct step, retains rejected values until changed and preserves existing hint associations.
Pending draft saves revalidate edited fields; final saves cannot create after earlier fields become invalid; Back cannot change steps during continuation.
limits: All owner sessions and API results were synthetic fixtures; account creation endpoints returned mocked validation failures.
Incomplete draft autosaves were intentionally allowed; this is not a no-write assertion.
No real email, provider call, customer account, deployment, environment change or external HTTP was performed by this QA task.
